description: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of training epochs for three datasets/groups, shown as three colored lines. The x-axis is labeled “Epochs,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0 to 3.0 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.5-epoch intervals (0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0). The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to about 0.35 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. The “Regular members” series is a blue solid line without visible markers, starting near 0.02 at the left edge, rising to around 0.05 by about 0.7–0.9 epochs, then fluctuating slightly and ending near 0.07 at 3.0 epochs. The “Members with near-duplicates” series is an orange solid line without visible markers, starting near 0.03, increasing steadily past 0.10 by roughly 0.6 epochs and past 0.20 by about 1.2 epochs, then rising further to around 0.33–0.34 near 2.0 epochs and ending around 0.36–0.37 at 3.0 epochs with small mid-course dips (e.g., a slight drop around ~2.1–2.3 epochs). The “Held-out data” series is a green solid line without visible markers, starting near 0.03, rising to roughly 0.04 by about 0.5 epochs, then staying near 0.03–0.04 with small oscillations, dipping to around 0.03 near ~1.8 epochs, and ending near 0.03–0.035 at 3.0 epochs.
